name: Makuruwan Arithmetic Human Quiz
author: cletous

sections.description: Makuruwan Arithmetic Human Quiz adds a lightweight arithmetic human-verification challenge to WordPress login and custom forms. It helps keep bots out without relying on Google reCAPTCHA or external services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/makuruwan-arithmetic-human-quiz/ and activate it.
  2. Go to Settings → Human Quiz to configure the quiz.
  3. To protect custom forms, add the shortcode [makarhq_human_check] inside your <form> markup.
sections.faq:
Can I protect only the login form?

Yes. You can enable or disable login protection in the plugin settings.

What shortcode should I use in custom forms?

Use [makarhq_human_check] inside your <form> tag so the fields are submitted with the form.
